Specification: This specification models a version of the prisoners and light-switch puzzle. It declares the set of prisoners, designates one distinguished prisoner as the counter, and introduces state variables for two switches, a per-prisoner switching count, and a global count maintained by the counter. The file provides constant/operator definitions, an invariant candidate `Inv == ~Done`, and a view expression, but it does not define the transition relation, initialization, or the temporal specification in this module.
